about: Spell part of a teleport request, put on the teleport helper entity by esv::teleport::ExecutionSystem::ProcessRequests (bg3.exe+0x3373FE0 lines 133-154) when RequestParams+0x28 is a valid entity: that entity, a copy of the request's eoc::spell_cast::InitialTarget (RequestParams+0x38, Toolkit LEGACY_DoTeleport EoCServer.dll+0x1150010 copies it with InitialTarget::InitialTarget) and RequestParams+0xA8. Its first member goes into FinishedEventOneFrameComponent+8 (bg3.exe+0x3373660 line 130-131). Creator bg3.exe+0x33753A0, destructor bg3.exe+0x22BDDA0. Not saved. The InitialTarget part equals Script Extender's eoc::spell_cast::InitialTarget (SpellCastShared.h: BaseTarget{VMT, Target, optional<EntityHandle> TargetProxy, optional<vec3> Position}, SpellType TargetingType, optional<BaseTarget> Target2) - Windows offsets agree with it.

evidence.says: bg3.exe+0x3373FE0 line 139: = RequestParams+0x28, only when that is a valid handle (line 133); creator writes the null handle. Read back into FinishedEventOneFrameComponent+8. Name inferred from the spell-cast target kept next to it.
Start of the InitialTarget (SE eoc::spell_cast::InitialTarget): creator sets +8 = &PTR_FUN_1454DB080 (its virtual table).
line 140: = RequestParams+0x40 (InitialTarget+8); creator: null handle. SE InitialTarget.Target.
lines 144-150: four dwords +0x28..+0x37 = RequestParams+0x58..+0x67; SE optional<vec3> Position.
line 151: byte = RequestParams+0x68; creator 0. SE InitialTarget.TargetingType (SpellType, 1 byte).

line 152: FUN_140F1D180(comp+0x40, RequestParams+0x70) = optional<BaseTarget> assignment (flag at +0x30 of it); destructor calls the virtual destructor at +0x40 when +0x70 is set. SE InitialTarget.Target2.
creator zeroes byte +0x70; destructor tests it.
creator writes 0xFFFFFFFF (null FixedString); destructor bg3.exe+0x22BDDA0 DecRefs +0x78 when != -1. Not written by ProcessRequests.

survey.live_reason: no live or captured instance: needs a situation that creates it
open_questions: Who writes the FixedString at +0x78 and what +0x7C holds (RequestParams+0xA8).
